test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary role of the Gram Panchayat in the Panchayati Raj System in India?

options.text: To conduct provincial elections, helping the Election Commission
To act as the judicial forum for local disputes
To serve as the executive body of village self-government

solution:
The correct answer is __**To serve as the executive body of village self-government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gram Panchayat is the **basic unit of local self-governance** in rural India under the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• It acts as the **executive body** responsible for implementing development programs and schemes for the welfare of the village.
 
• Key responsibilities include **maintaining village infrastructure, sanitation, water supply, and public health**.
 
• Gram Panchayats are headed by the elected representative known as the **Sarpanch**, assisted by other members.
 
• It also plays a role in ensuring **community participation and governance** at the grassroots level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj System:**

 
 
• It is a three-tier system of governance comprising **Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zila Parishad (district level)**.
 
• It was institutionalized through the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**.
 
• This system aims to **decentralize governance** and enhance democratic participation at the grassroots level.
 
 
 
• **Funding of Gram Panchayats:**
 
 
• Gram Panchayats receive funds through **taxes, government grants, and contributions from villagers**.
 
• Central and state governments provide financial assistance under schemes like **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**.
 
 
 
• **Sarpanch:**
 
 
• The Sarpanch is the elected head of the Gram Panchayat and acts as the **primary decision-maker and representative**.
 
• They are responsible for presiding over meetings and ensuring the execution of resolutions passed by the Panchayat.
 
 
 
• **Gram Sabha:**
 
 
• The Gram Sabha consists of all registered voters in the village and serves as the **general assembly of the village**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in **decision-making and oversight** of the Gram Panchayat's activities.
